product.name: support_tickets
product.description: A domain-owned data product containing customer support ticket information, issue categories, priorities, ticket statuses, and resolution details.

business_context.business_purpose: Monitor customer issues, ticket resolution performance, workload, priorities, and customer support operations.

quality_checks: Priority must be Low, Medium, or High
Status must be Open, In Progress, or Resolved
Resolution hours must not be negative
Resolved tickets must have resolution information
Open and In Progress tickets must not have resolution information
Resolution timestamp must not precede ticket creation timestamp
Resolution hours must match the timestamp difference

service_expectations.availability_expectation: Available to authorized data product consumers

limitations: The dataset is a simulated sample dataset
The dataset contains only 10 support tickets
Customer identifiers are included but direct personal information is not included
The dataset is not representative of actual support operations
